description: Mistral 7B is Mistral AI's foundational 7B parameter open-weights model featuring Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and Sliding-Window Attention for efficient inference. It outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks and supports function calling in v0.3.

architecture.type: Decoder-only Transformer with GQA and Sliding-Window Attention

trainingData.description: Trained on diverse text data. Specific composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Pre-training with architectural optimizations. Instruct variants include instruction tuning.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Outperforms Llama 2 13B on all tested benchmarks while being smaller. Strong efficiency through GQA and sliding-window attention.

benchmarks.note: Outperforms Llama 2 13B on all tested benchmarks

knownLimitations: Smaller than larger models in the family
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning applied to Instruct variants.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Open weights allow local deployment for privacy-sensitive applications.

requirements.deployment: Local deployment, edge deployment, or cloud deployment

hardware.7B: GPU recommended, ~14GB VRAM for full precision
